Why Take Our
Placement Test?

It's Accurate.

It's Convenient.

Test from anywhere. Works on your phone, tablet, or computer — all you need is a quiet spot and an internet connection.

It's Free.

No cost, no catch. Get your CEFR level plus a personal course recommendation from our team — completely free.
